home.heroIntroduction: Senior software engineer with 10+ years of experience building full-stack applications, search and analytics systems, data pipelines, and high-traffic real-time products. I work primarily with TypeScript, React, Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, and AWS, with a focus on reliable systems and clear, maintainable user experiences.
home.about: Most recently, I worked as a Senior Software Engineer at Mobian, building full-stack search, analytics, reporting, data-processing, and reliability features for an audience-intelligence and advertising platform. Before that, I built clinical-study tools at Faro Health and led frontend modernization work for Cams at Various Inc.
home.section1Content1: In my most recent role as a Senior Full-Stack Developer at pharmaceutical tech startup Faro Health, I built and optimized REST and CQRS-based microservices and UI modules using TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Jest, and React. I developed feature slices and POCs, designed and executed technical solutions, wrote unit and integration tests, optimized application performance, and built deployment pipelines with GitHub Actions.
home.section1Content2: Previously, I led an international remote front-end team at Various Inc., collaborating closely with designers to modernize legacy JavaScript and Perl-based video streaming apps. We migrated them to a scalable, high-performance React and TypeScript stack with Next.js, MOBX, WebSockets, and Python, backed by REST APIs and a CI/CD pipeline for seamless deployment.

content.1:
Clinical-study design platform

I contributed to Faro Study Designer, a healthcare product used to plan, document, and evaluate clinical protocols. My work focused on shipping maintainable product features across TypeScript, React, service integrations, PostgreSQL-backed workflows, automated tests, and deployment pipelines.

Contribution and outcomes

  • Built frontend and full-stack feature slices for study-design workflows
  • Integrated UI modules with REST and CQRS-style service boundaries
  • Improved reliability with unit and integration tests
  • Supported delivery through GitHub Actions and repeatable release practices

The result was clearer product behavior, stronger test coverage, and a more maintainable path for evolving clinical-study features.
content.2:
Cams real-time product modernization

I led frontend modernization work for Cams, a mature high-traffic platform with live discovery, video, chat, public rooms, and private interactive sessions. The work required preserving active product behavior while moving legacy JavaScript and Perl-backed experiences toward a scalable React, TypeScript, Next.js, WebSocket, and Python architecture.

Contribution and outcomes

  • Coordinated an international frontend team across product, design, and engineering priorities
  • Improved discovery, presence, chat, and session-state interfaces
  • Supported real-time UI updates without disrupting long-running media experiences
  • Helped reduce legacy complexity by moving product surfaces into a more maintainable frontend stack

The outcome was a clearer and more dependable foundation for real-time interaction-heavy workflows on an established production platform.
content.3: A wordpress website for the The 2025 San Anselmo General Plan Update which provides residents with comprehensive information on proposed changes to the town's infrastructure, zoning, and public spaces. It features detailed project updates, sustainability initiatives, and transportation improvements. The site also includes interactive public surveys, allowing community members to provide feedback and participate in the decision-making process.
content.4: Launch Brigade is a web design and development agency based in the San Francisco Bay Area, specializing in creating digital experiences that elevate brands and drive business growth. Their website, launchbrigade.com, reflects their commitment to delivering comprehensive digital solutions.
content.5: The Data Analytics Dashboard was a proof of concept application built in Pandas which utilized Study Design data stored in a star schema to create a data analytics microservice and frontend. This app allowed users to slice and dice their study data according to whatever data dimensions they chose.
content.6: An IDP agnostic Single Sign On implementation for the study designer application. Built to allow interchangeable organizations to use their own SAML and Oauth identity provider services to provide tokens for interacting with our api.
content.7: Lotlinx is an AI-driven automotive inventory management platform that leverages machine learning and extensive data analytics to help dealerships optimize inventory turnover and profitability. By providing real-time insights into market demand, pricing strategies, and consumer behavior, Lotlinx enables use car dealers to make data-driven decisions, reduce holding costs, and enhance overall operational efficiency.
content.8: ​Metafold 3D is a cloud-based platform that enables the design and engineering of highly complex 3D models, specifically optimized for additive manufacturing. content.9:
Persona & Channel Intelligence

At Mobian, I built search, filtering, analytics, and export features for an audience-intelligence platform used to discover personas, evaluate content channels, and review performance data.

Contribution and outcomes

  • Implemented persona and channel search with server-side autocomplete, pagination, and infinite scrolling
  • Added date-range filtering, channel statistics, history views, and reliable loading states
  • Built frontend proxy routes, search limits, logging, and streamed CSV exports that preserved active filters
  • Traced behavior across React, Next.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, Redis, caches, and scheduled processing

These changes made discovery and export workflows faster, more reliable, and easier to operate across large search and aggregation workloads.
content.10:
Context Ingestion & Brand-Safety Tooling

I built data-processing and reliability improvements for contextual-intelligence and brand-safety systems handling webpage, URL, video, channel, and classification metadata.

Contribution and outcomes

  • Added full-context schema fields and metadata persistence
  • Built bounded cleanup, URL-prefix, alias, and batch-processing tools
  • Improved checkpoint and retry behavior while preserving promoted aliases
  • Strengthened channel discovery with URL parsing, ID scanning, HTML fallback, caching, and pruning
  • Added structured AWS diagnostics for lookup and processing failures

The work improved data quality, recovery paths, and operational visibility across high-throughput metadata pipelines.
content.11:
Advertising Operations & Reporting Integrations

I connected advertiser, audience-segment, targeting, reporting, and export workflows across Mobian's advertising analytics systems.

Contribution and outcomes

  • Added advertiser and reporting-entity support across multiple advertising platforms
  • Improved server-side search, sorting, duplicate-name disambiguation, and source-qualified labels
  • Built placement-to-line-item mapping and reporting-cache improvements
  • Delivered segment and advertiser-gallery CSV exports that preserved active filters and pagination
  • Fixed frontend behavior across advertiser, campaign-control, and segment workflows

These changes made reporting data easier to find, export, reconcile, and use across operational workflows.
content.12:
Platform Engineering, Testing & Product Infrastructure

I worked on cross-cutting reliability and delivery improvements spanning product areas, services, cloud infrastructure, and developer workflows.

Contribution and outcomes

  • Created semantic design tokens, Material UI variants, palette bridging, and migration examples
  • Modernized Cypress configuration, authenticated smoke tests, Playwright coverage, and reusable fixtures
  • Improved scheduled serverless jobs, cloud diagnostics, observability, containers, and infrastructure configuration
  • Supported framework security updates, authentication handling, release coordination, and technical documentation

The result was safer delivery, stronger test coverage, clearer UI foundations, and lower operational risk across frontend, backend, ETL, search, and deployment systems.
content.13:
Frontend UI & Design System

I built and refined reusable frontend experiences across Mobian's audience-intelligence and advertising analytics platform, focusing on clarity, consistency, responsiveness, and reliable interaction behavior.

Contribution and outcomes

  • Improved search, autocomplete, filtering, pagination, infinite scrolling, loading states, and empty-state behavior
  • Built reusable Material UI components, semantic design tokens, palette bridging, variants, and migration patterns
  • Delivered responsive dashboard, gallery, table, drawer, dropdown, and export interfaces
  • Improved frontend API proxying, URL-state synchronization, query handling, and error states
  • Added coverage with Jest, Cypress, Playwright, authenticated fixtures, and smoke tests

These changes made complex data workflows easier to scan, operate, test, and maintain across the full product experience.
